_note: Synthetic, non-graphic examples written for the demo and as a seed for the evaluation set. Channels are fictional; 'side' is used only to check that both sides are treated equally. Real posts would mostly be in Russian or Ukrainian.

posts.text: When we get to their villages, their women will learn what it means to resist us.
Tell the occupiers: whatever they did in our towns, we will do the same to their wives. They will pay.
Our boys earned their little 'reward' in that basement 😂 well done lads
The captured soldiers got what they deserved in that cell. No pity. Proud of our guys.
New meme dropped: the 'liberation' package now includes free visits to your wife lol
Joke of the day: why do their prisoners walk funny? 🤣 you know why
The woman who spoke to the UN about the soldiers in [village] — her name is [NAME] and she lives on [STREET]. Everyone should know.
Who is she? The girl in the interview about the checkpoint. Send me her profile, I want to find her family.
Any woman who stayed under occupation is spoiled now. No one will marry them, and their families should be ashamed.
If she went to the soldiers' party she asked for it. Stop calling these girls victims.
The so-called rape reports from [town] are staged by foreign NGOs. Crisis actors, all of them. Fake.
BREAKING: enemy commanders ordered mass rape in every village, 10,000 victims confirmed! No source needed, everyone knows.
Heard from a cousin that soldiers took two women from a shelter near [village] last night. Unconfirmed, does anyone know more?
People are saying the guards at the filtration point did something to the men there. Rumour for now.
The UN Commission of Inquiry report documented cases of sexual violence against detainees and called for accountability.
OHCHR says it has documented new reports of sexual violence in detention and urged all parties to allow independent monitors.
I was held for three weeks. What happened to me there was not my fault. I am speaking so other women know they are not alone.
If you or someone you know experienced sexual violence, help is available. Our support line is free, confidential and open 24/7.
Power cuts expected in the east tonight. Charge your phones and check on elderly neighbours.
Prisoner exchange completed this morning: 95 people returned home, according to officials on both sides.
